explication: This repository is primarily a catalog and updater for AI-agent skills, with a large collection of local skill packages. The main workflow is to run an update (once or on a schedule), collect and organize skill metadata, persist the catalog, then let users browse or export it. The README also documents catalog statistics and a skill-format validator. Some runtime wiring is inferred from the README and imports; unsampled implementation details are not represented as definite calls.
